suppress.notes: False positive: CPE confusion. CVE-2015-0897 targets the "LINE" Android/iOS messenger app (cpe:2.3:a:line:line) and has nothing to do with the pitest mutation testing library.
False positive: CPE confusion. CVE-2022-31691 affects Spring Tools 4 for Eclipse and a set of VSCode plugins; it does not apply to the Spring Boot runtime devtools dependency.

False positive: CPE confusion. The opentelemetry-semconv Java jars are constants-only; the umbrella cpe:/a:opentelemetry:opentelemetry attributes OpenTelemetry-Go SDK CVEs (CVE-2026-29181, CVE-2026-24051, CVE-2026-39883) to them by pure version-number overlap.

False positive: CPE confusion (companion to the CPE-level entry). CVE-2026-29181, CVE-2026-24051, CVE-2026-39883, CVE-2026-39882 and CVE-2026-41178 are OpenTelemetry-Go SDK vulnerabilities attributed to the constants-only Java semconv jars.

False positive: CVE-2026-53914 targets the Kotlin build toolchain's build-cache metadata deserialization, not the runtime kotlin-stdlib jar we ship transitively via okhttp/okio; this project compiles no Kotlin sources.

False positive: CPE confusion. CVE-2026-54285 is an inbound-baggage size-limit gap in opentelemetry-JS (@opentelemetry/core before 2.8.0); the umbrella cpe:/a:opentelemetry:opentelemetry attributes it to every io.opentelemetry Java jar by version-number overlap. The Java SDK's own counterpart, CVE-2026-45292, is fixed in 1.62.0, which opentelemetry-api and opentelemetry-extension-trace-propagators resolve on every classpath of this build (2026-09-23).

False positive: CPE confusion. CVE-2026-42582 affects netty-codec-http3 in the 4.2.0-4.2.12 range; the netty 4.1.x line ships no HTTP/3 codec, and these jars are Keycloak-container-provided compile-time deps anyway.

False positive: CPE confusion + build-time-only. CVE-2026-54399/CVE-2026-54428 affect Apache HttpComponents Core 5.x (httpcore5/httpcore5-h2, HTTP/1.1 parser and HTTP/2 HPACK decoder); our httpcore 4.4.x jars are the legacy 4.x line (no HTTP/2 code path), present only on the keycloak-spi compile/checkstyle/test classpaths and on no basetool runtime classpath. No httpcore5 5.x is shipped.

False positive: build-time-only + CPE expansion. CVE-2026-15075 (vertx-core HttpClient cross-origin redirect header leak) and CVE-2026-15076 (vertx-web-client WebClientSession cross-domain cookie injection, whose vulnerable class is not even on the classpath) affect Eclipse Vert.x 4.5.29 and earlier. Under Keycloak 26.7.4 our vertx-core / vertx-grpc* jars resolve to 4.5.31, above the 4.5.30 fix; the only coordinate still inside the affected range is vertx-codegen 4.5.26. All of them are compileOnly transitives of keycloak-services 26.7.4 (via Quarkus) on the keycloak-spi module only, absent from every basetool runtime classpath and container-provided by Keycloak at runtime (re-verified 2026-09-17).
